# Draft:A war Inside song by Thomas May

----
https://www.facebook.com/share/1ANje1i7g7/
A War Inside is the first single off the album "A Letter Home" by American musician, songwriter and multi-instrumentalist, Thomas May.
The song, release on February 25th, 2025, features lyrics that deal with loss, loneliness, drug abuse and recovery and pain. A [https://open.spotify.com/album/28IJmSlMzUcC4piYb5IBVe?si=7mQDtpBKRmiyzgBVajEL9w vivid] picture of the world the "storyteller" is experiencing.
With a haunting, echoing sound, pacing and delivery, restraining emotion in order to deliver the message. The lyrics lean hard into vulnerability and openness about the pain being felt.
